patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: The worst headache of my entire life hit me like a thunderclap — instant, full force, like I got hit in the back of the head. It's a little better now, but I feel awful and my neck's stiff.
presentation.triageNote: 45-year-old male with an instantaneous, worst-ever headache that was maximal from the first moment. He describes being struck in the back of the head, has neck stiffness, and remains in severe pain despite slight improvement.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because an instantaneous worst-ever headache with neck stiffness is a high-risk neurologic presentation even if pain has improved slightly.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient describes a thunderclap headache maximal at onset, persistent severe pain, and neck stiffness.
clinical.acuityReason: The onset pattern raises concern for acute intracranial bleeding and requires rapid imaging rather than routine headache treatment.
expectedResources: Vascular imaging or lumbar puncture when indicated
teachingPoints: Partial spontaneous improvement does not exclude intracranial hemorrhage.
Time from onset affects the sensitivity and sequence of diagnostic testing.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Urgent brain and vascular evaluation would determine the need for neurosurgical treatment and monitored admission.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: one hand on the back of his head, the other on his neck
signs: holding the back of his head
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. ANATOMY AND OBJECTS (critical): exactly one head, exactly two arms ending in exactly two hands, exactly two legs ending in two feet, five fingers on each hand. No extra, duplicated, floating or partial limbs anywhere. Anything the character touches must be plausibly held by one of those two hands. All furniture is solid and fully opaque - the chair must never look transparent or see-through, and its back, seat and legs must all be completely drawn. Subject: a white 45-year-old man, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: one hand pressed to the back of his head, the other on his neck. Expression: wincing and pained. Clearly visible: a hand cradling the back of the head and a hand on a stiff neck. No text, no logos.
